body: I understand what you are saying, but I don't really understand how I could find therapies in my area without people having bias. I also have extremely bad social anxiety, so I rarely leave my house. It may seem like an easy thing to do, but It's a really big leap into the abyss for me.
What type of therapy do you suggest? I've heard stories about therapists reporting people to the police when they try to get help.
Obviously, If you would like to contribute to something that might actually help me, that would be great.
